description: MedAdhere clinician dashboard — Next.js 15 App Router auth shell (Phase 2)

comments.next-pin: H6/D-15: next is installed as ^15.5.22 and capped to the 15.x line (>=15.5.9 <16). Amplify Hosting (D-01, WEB_COMPUTE) supports only up to Next 15; an unbounded >=15.5.9 resolves to 16.x and breaks the SSR build (SC3). >=15.5.9 is the fully-patched CVE-2025-55184/67779 floor. The <16 cap may be lifted only once Amplify adds Next-16 support, or under the Vercel fallback (D-02).
comments.jose-pin: D-07: jose ^6.2.3 is the ONLY Edge-safe verifier (Web Crypto). The Node-only Cognito/JWT verify libraries break on the Edge runtime (Pitfall 1).
